title: Concept: Shell command executed through Open3 from a string in ruby — review required
description: In ruby, Open3 runs a command string. The library offers an argument-array form that avoids the shell entirely, so the string form is an avoidable choice; once a request value is interpolated, the shell decides where commands begin and end.
applicability: ruby services and jobs that call external programs.
risk: Shell injection with application privileges; HIGH severity.
